title: Placement Aptitude, Logical Reasoning & Verbal Ability Test - Day 11
description: Modern placement-style assessment covering quantitative aptitude, analytical reasoning, verbal ability, and workplace problem solving.

questions.question: A product's price is increased by 25%. By what percentage must the increased price be reduced to return to the original price?
A train covers the first half of a journey at 40 km/h and the second half at 60 km/h. What is its average speed for the entire journey?
Five students A, B, C, D, and E are standing in a line. A is ahead of B, B is ahead of C, and D is behind E. Which arrangement satisfies all the conditions?
A student scored 72, 68, 81, and 79 in four tests. What score is needed in the fifth test to obtain an average of 75?
A team must choose exactly two projects from four projects: P, Q, R, and S. P and Q cannot be selected together. If R is selected, S must also be selected. Which pair is valid?
Choose the word that best completes the sentence: The manager asked the team to remain ___ while dealing with the unexpected client request.

A software team receives three bug reports. Bug X prevents users from logging in, Bug Y changes the color of a button, and Bug Z affects a rarely used report. Which should normally receive the highest priority?
A company has 240 applicants. 30% are shortlisted after the first screening, and half of the shortlisted candidates pass the next round. How many candidates reach the final round?
A team completes its weekly tasks on time, but repeated mistakes require additional rework. Which improvement would most directly address the problem?
options: Improve the review and quality-check process
Reduce the number of tasks assigned

questions.question: An email to a placement coordinator needs to request permission to attend an interview during class hours. Which sentence is most professional?
options: I won't be in class, so please manage it.
I have an interview during class and need permission to attend it. I would appreciate your approval.
I am going for an interview, so I will miss class.
Let me attend the interview because it is important.

questions.question: A delivery team completed 80% of its assigned orders by 4 PM. The remaining orders are expected to take another 2 hours. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: The team has completed all orders
The team may complete the remaining orders by around 6 PM
The team will definitely finish before 5 PM
The remaining orders have already been cancelled

questions.question: A password consists of 3 different digits chosen from 0 to 9. How many possible passwords can be formed if the first digit cannot be 0?
A company receives 500 applications. 40% pass the first screening. Of those shortlisted, 25% are invited for an interview. How many candidates are invited?
Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The team have completed its project.
The team has completed its project.
The team has complete its project.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'resilient'.
